This supposition, which we may call the Rylean account (since it is most explicitly defended in Ryle 1949, 25–61)[^ryle-1949], has been challenged by intellectualists about know how, notably Stanley and Williamson (2001). Intellectualists argue that knowing how to perform an action is a matter of knowing a certain proposition. Stanley and Williamson’s account draws on observations about the standard treatment of embedded questions (‘know who’, ‘know where’, and so forth; see Karttunen 1977)[^karttunen-1977] to defend this idea. Specifically, they propose that knowing how to *A* is knowing that some way is a way for one to *A*. On this view, then, knowing how to *A* is clearly not the same thing as having an ability to *A*.
zh: 有人会期望能力的说明同时也是知道如何（knowledge how）的说明，其假设是：当且仅当一个人有能力实施某个行动时，他才知道如何实施该行动。这个假设可称为赖尔式说明（Rylean account）（因为最明确地为它辩护的是 Ryle 1949, 25–61）[^ryle-1949]，它已受到关于知道如何的理智主义者的挑战，代表是 Stanley 与 Williamson（2001）。理智主义者主张，知道如何实施一个行动，在于知道某个命题。Stanley 与 Williamson 的说明借助对嵌问句标准处理方式的观察（“知道是谁”“知道在哪里”等等；见 Karttunen 1977）[^karttunen-1977]来为这一想法辩护。具体来说，他们提出：知道如何实施 *A*，就是知道某个方式是实施 *A* 的方式。按这种看法，知道如何实施 *A* 显然不等于有能力实施 *A*。

en: Authors who reject the Rylean account may nonetheless wish to uphold one of two weaker Rylean theses. (It bears noting that Stanley and Williamson reject both.) First, one might defend the Sufficiency Thesis, which says that ability implies know how. The Sufficiency thesis is incompatible with the intellectualist claim that know how requires knowledge of some proposition. Second, one might defend the Necessity Thesis, according to which know how implies ability. The Necessity Thesis is compatible with the view that know how requires (in addition to ability) knowledge of a certain proposition.
zh: 拒绝赖尔式说明的作者仍可能希望坚持两条较弱的赖尔式论题之一（值得注意的是，Stanley 与 Williamson 两条都拒绝）。第一，可以为充分性论题辩护：能力蕴含知道如何。充分性论题与“知道如何需要关于某个命题的知识”这一理智主义主张不相容。第二，可以为必要性论题辩护：知道如何蕴含能力。必要性论题与“知道如何（除能力外）还需要关于某个命题的知识”相容。

en: Still, also the Necessity Thesis has been challenged, often by appeal to cases like the following (adapted from Stanley and Williamson 2001)[^stanley-2001]. Imagine a retired ski instructor who is no longer physically capable of descending the slopes. One might think that it is possible for the ski instructor to retain their knowledge how to ski even when they have lost their physical ability. Intuitively, they might still be able to impart their know how on others. This suggests that know how does not imply ability.
zh: 不过，必要性论题也受到了挑战，挑战常常诉诸如下类型的案例（改编自 Stanley and Williamson 2001）[^stanley-2001]：设想一位退役滑雪教练，他已不再具备下坡的身体条件。人们可能认为，滑雪教练在丧失身体能力之后仍可保有知道如何滑雪。直观上说，他或许仍能把这种知道如何传授给别人。这表明知道如何并不蕴含能力。

en: A common way for defendants of the Necessity Thesis to respond to cases like these is to say that whether know how implies ability depends on our understanding of ability. In particular, if it suffices for ability that one can perform an act succesfully in some (set of) relevant circumstances (where these circumstances need not actually obtain), then there may be a sense in which the ski instructor in the example retains their ability to ski. It is ability in this sense, the argument goes, that is implied by knowledge how (for further discussion see Hawley 2003 and Cath 2019)[^cath-2019][^hawley-2003]. Another response (developed in Boylan 2024)[^boylan-2024] is to propose that there are two different readings of know how claims. On one reading, know how entails ability; on another it does not. The question then is whether any extant account of know how can explain both these readings.
zh: 必要性论题的辩护者回应这类案例的常见方式是说：知道如何是否蕴含能力，取决于我们如何理解能力。具体而言，如果一个人能在某些（一组）相关境况中成功地实施某行动（这些境况无须实际成立）就足以算有能力，那么在这个意义上，例中的滑雪教练仍保有滑雪的能力。论证接着说，知道如何所蕴含的正是这种意义上的能力（进一步讨论见 Hawley 2003 与 Cath 2019）[^cath-2019][^hawley-2003]。另一种回应（见 Boylan 2024）[^boylan-2024]是提出“知道如何”的断言有两种读法：按一种读法，知道如何蕴含能力；按另一种则不然。于是问题变成：现存的任何一种知道如何说明，能否同时解释这两种读法。

en: Whatever our view of ability’s relation to know how, there is a further question at the intersection of these topics that bears consideration: how should we accommodate skills? Skillful action is often thought to involve a cognitive component. This suggests that having a skill is closely connected to having propositional knowledge. In line with this, some authors propose to adopt an intellectualist account of skill. For instance, Pavese and Beddor (2023) defend the view that skills are propositional knowledge states. On this view, knowledge how reduces to knowledge that, and having a skill to *A* just is having knowledge how to *A*. Therefore, having a skill reduces to having knowledge of some proposition.
zh: 无论我们对能力与知道如何之关系持何种看法，这两个论题的交汇处还有一个值得考虑的进一步问题：我们该如何安置技能（skills）？技能性行动常被认为包含一个认知成分。这提示：拥有技能与拥有命题知识密切相连。与此相一致，一些作者主张对技能采取理智主义说明。例如 Pavese 与 Beddor（2023）为“技能就是命题知识状态”这一观点辩护。按这种看法，知道如何还原为知道什么，而拥有实施 *A* 的技能恰恰就是拥有实施 *A* 的知道如何。因此，拥有技能就还原为拥有关于某个命题的知识。

en: Alternatively, one might suggest that having a skill is best understood as having an ability that meets certain further conditions. One oft-mentioned condition that is thought to distinguish skills from other abilities is that developing and maintaining a skill requires practice (e.g., McGeer 2018; Robb 2020; Shepherd 2021; Fridland 2021)[^fridland-2021][^mcgeer-2018][^robb-2020][^shepherd-2021]. Another influential suggestion concerning what sets skills apart is that their exercise involves “strategic control” (Fridland 2014, 2021)[^fridland-2014]. This is to say that “skilled agents are able to modify, adjust and adapt their practical intentions in ways that are appropriate, effective, and flexible given their overall goals” (Fridland 2021, p. 5939)[^fridland-2021]. This view allows that knowledge of certain propositions (e.g., ‘it is best to wait with *A*’ing given my circumstances’) plays an important role in skilled action, without suggesting that skill reduces to propositional knowledge.
zh: 另一种想法是：拥有技能最好理解为拥有一种满足若干附加条件的能力。人们常提到的一个用于区分技能与其他能力的条件是：发展并维持一项技能需要练习（如 McGeer 2018；Robb 2020；Shepherd 2021；Fridland 2021）[^fridland-2021][^mcgeer-2018][^robb-2020][^shepherd-2021]。另一个关于技能何以卓然自立的有影响建议是：技能的施行涉及“策略性控制”（Fridland 2014, 2021）[^fridland-2014]。也就是说，“技能娴熟的行动者能够以适当、有效而灵活的方式修改、调整与适配其实践意图，以切合其总体目标”（Fridland 2021, p. 5939）[^fridland-2021]。这种看法允许关于某些命题的知识（例如“就我的处境而言，最好暂缓实施 *A*”）在技能性行动中扮演重要角色，而不必主张技能还原为命题知识。

en: Ultimately, accurately accounting for the nature of know how, skill, and their relationship to abilities remains an open and intriguing problem. For further discussion of the relation between ability and know how, see the entry on knowledge how.
zh: 归根结底，准确说明知道如何与技能的本性及其与能力的关系，仍是一个开放而引人入胜的问题。关于能力与知道如何之关系的进一步讨论，参见关于如何做某事的知识词条。

en: 2. Distinctions in ability
zh: 2 能力中的诸区分

en: If one wants to give a theory of ability of the sort described at the outset, it is helpful for that theory to observe some formal distinctions that have been marked in the literature. This section canvasses some of the most important distinctions.
zh: 如果想给出开头所述那种意义上的能力理论，让理论遵守文献中已标出的若干形式区分会很有帮助。本节考察其中最重要的几个区分。

en: 2.1 General and specific ability
zh: 2.1 一般能力与特定能力

en: The previous section was primarily concerned with distinguishing abilities from other powers. But there is also a distinction to be made within the class of abilities itself. This is the distinction between *general* and *specific* abilities (Honoré 1964; Mele 2003)[^honoré-1964][^mele-2003].
zh: 上一节主要关心把能力与其他诸力区分开来。但能力这个类内部也有一个区分需要做出：这就是 ** 一般 ** （general）能力与 ** 特定 ** （specific）能力之间的区分（Honoré 1964；Mele 2003）[^honoré-1964][^mele-2003]。

en: The distinction between general and specific abilities may be brought out by way of example. Consider a well-trained tennis player equipped with ball and racquet, standing at the service line. There is, as it were, nothing standing between her and a serve: every prerequisite for her serving has been met. Such an agent is *in a position to* serve, or has serving as an *option*. Let us say that such an agent has the *specific ability* to serve.
zh: 一般与特定之别可以借例子来呈现。设想一位训练有素的网球运动员，手持球与球拍站在发球线上。可以说，她与一次发球之间没有任何东西阻隔：她发球的一切前提条件都已满足。这样一位行动者 ** 处于可以发球的位置 ** （in a position to），或者发球对她是一个 ** 选项 ** （option）。让我们说，这样的行动者拥有发球的 ** 特定能力 **。

en: In contrast, consider an otherwise similar tennis player who lacks a racquet and ball, and is miles away from a tennis court. There is clearly a good sense in which such an agent has the ability to hit a serve: she has been trained to do so, and has done so many times in the past. Yet such an agent lacks the *specific ability* to serve, as that term was just defined. Let us say that such an agent has the *general ability* to serve.
zh: 相比之下，设想另一位在其他方面都相似的网球运动员，她没有球拍和球，而且距离网球场数英里之遥。显然，在一种良好的意义上，这样一位行动者拥有击出发球的能力：她受过这种训练，过去也曾多次做到。然而，按刚才的定义，这样一位行动者缺乏发球的 ** 特定能力 **。让我们说，这样的行动者拥有发球的 ** 一般能力 **。

en: The concern of this article will be general abilities in this sense, and unqualified references to ‘ability’ should be read in that way. But specific abilities will also be at issue. This is for at least two reasons.
zh: 本文关心的是这种意义上的一般能力；凡不加限定的“能力”都应按此读法理解。但特定能力同样会进入讨论，这至少有两个理由。

en: The first is one of coverage: many of the proposals that are relevant to the understanding of ability, especially the classical ‘conditional analysis’ (discussed in Section 3.1 below), are naturally read as proposals about specific ability in the present sense, and a suitably broad conception of ability lets us keep these proposals within our domain of discussion.
zh: 第一个理由是覆盖面：与理解能力相关的许多提案——尤其是经典的“条件句分析”（见下文第 3.1 节）——按当下的术语自然要读作关于特定能力的提案，而一个足够宽的能力概念使我们能把这些提案留在讨论范围之内。

en: The second reason is more properly philosophical. If we accept the distinction between general and specific abilities, then we want for our account of ability to accommodate both of them, and ultimately to explain how they are related to each other. For this distinction is not plausibly diagnosed as mere ambiguity; it rather marks off something like two modes of a single kind of power. There are at least two kinds of proposals one may make here. One, arguably implicit in many of the ‘new dispositionalist’ approaches to ability (§3.4), is that general ability is in some sense prior to specific ability: to have a specific ability is simply to have a general ability and to meet some further constraint, such as having an opportunity. Another proposal (suggested in Maier 2015)[^maier-2015] is that specific ability is in some sense prior to general ability: to have a general ability is simply to have a specific ability under a certain range of circumstances.
zh: 第二个理由更具哲学性。如果我们接受一般与特定能力之分，那么我们希望关于能力的说明能同时容纳二者，并最终说明二者如何相互关联。因为这个区分不大可能被诊断为单纯的多义；它更像是标出了同一种力之下的两种样态。在此至少可以提出两类提案。其一是“一般能力在某种意义上先于特定能力”：拥有特定能力，不过是拥有一般能力并满足某个进一步约束（例如拥有机会）而已。这一提案可以说隐含在许多“新倾向主义”（new dispositionalist）进路中（§3.4）。另一提案（Maier 2015 提出）[^maier-2015]则是“特定能力在某种意义上先于一般能力”：拥有一般能力，不过是在某一范围内的境况下拥有特定能力而已。

en: The idea that there is some sort of bipartite distinction to be made between abilities has been a prominent theme in contemporary work on ability. It has been endorsed and developed, in different contexts, by Whittle (2010), Glick (2012) and Vihvelin (2013). However, the bipartite distinctions introduced by these authors differ from one another in certain respects. How should we interpret this divergence? It could be that there exist *several* bipartite distinctions and that each proposed view tracks one of these. Alternatively, there might be a single distinction, so that only one of the classifications introduced by these (and other) authors tracks a genuine difference between two modes of ability.
zh: 能力可以做出某种二分——这一想法是当代能力研究的一个突出主题。Whittle（2010）、Glick（2012）与 Vihvelin（2013）在不同语境中认可并发展了它。然而，这些作者引入的二分在某些方面彼此不同。我们该如何解读这种分歧？可能存在 ** 好几个 ** 二分，而每家提出的观点各自追踪其中一个；也可能只存在一个区分，于是这些（及其他）作者引入的分类中只有一个是真正追踪了能力两种样态之间的差异。

en: 2.2 Further distinctions
zh: 2.2 进一步的区分

en: Besides the distinction between general and specific abilities, theorists of ability have proposed several further classifications. In this section, we discuss three of them. The first, developed by Simon Kittle (2015) differentiates *global* and *local* abilities. Kittle proposes that abilities can be thought of as ‘general’ in two different ways. On the one hand, abilities can be general in the sense already outlined: these are abilities that an agent may be said to possess even if she cannot exercise them given her circumstances. On the other hand, abilities can be ‘general’ (we will henceforth use ‘global’ to avoid terminological confusion) in the sense that they can be exercised across a wide range of possible circumstances. Local abilities, in contrast, can be exercised in only a narrow range of circumstances.
zh: 除一般与特定之分外，能力理论家还提出了若干进一步的分类。本节讨论其中三种。第一种由 Simon Kittle（2015）发展，区分 ** 全域 ** （global）能力与 ** 局部 ** （local）能力。Kittle 提出，能力可以在两种不同意义上“一般”。一方面，能力可以在已概述过的意义上是一般的：即使行动者在其处境下无法施行，这些能力仍可说为她所拥有。另一方面，能力也可以在如下意义上“一般”（为避免术语混淆，下文改用“全域”）：它们可以在广泛范围内的可能境况中施行。相比之下，局部能力只能在狭窄范围的境况中施行。

en: Plausibly, the distinction between global and local abilities isn’t binary but indicative of a spectrum: general abilities may be more or less global. To see this, let us return to the example of the tennis player who has a general (but not a specific) ability to serve. Suppose the tennis player is able to hit a serve only in conditions particularly conducive to playing tennis (e.g., minimal wind; access to a well-maintained court and racket; no distractions). The narrow range of conditions in which the agent can exercise her ability doesn’t make that ability specific. After all, the conditions specified need not actually obtain. But it does make the ability local.
zh: 可以相信，全域与局部之分并非二值，而指示着一个谱系：一般能力可以或多或少是全域的。为看清这一点，回到那位拥有（但不拥有特定）发球能力的网球运动员。假设这位运动员只在特别有利于打网球的条件下（例如：几乎无风；能使用维护良好的球场与球拍；没有干扰）才能击出发球。行动者能施行其能力的条件范围狭窄，并不使该能力变成特定能力——毕竟所列条件无须实际成立——但它确实使该能力成为局部能力。

en: Another, arguably more basic distinction is that between *simple* and *intentional* abilities. As Mele (2003) points out, there is a sense in which agents are able to do whatever they in fact do. For example, an agent who rolls a six with a fair die was able (in the simple sense) to do so. Yet there is also another sense of ability which requires that the agent is, in some relevant way, in control (though for a recent objection to the view that there is such a sense of ability see Mandelkern 2024)[^mandelkern-2024]. Mele calls ability in this more controlled sense an intentional ability. How much control over one’s performance is required to have an intentional ability is contentious. As in the case of the previous classification, one might think that the notions of ‘simple’ and ‘intentional’ ability indicate the existence of a gradient rather than a strict binary distinction: agents may have more or less control over the performance of an act.
zh: 另一个可以说更基本的区分，是 ** 单纯 ** （simple）能力与 ** 意向 ** （intentional）能力之分。正如 Mele（2003）指出的，在一种意义上，行动者能做他们事实上做的一切。例如，用一颗均匀骰子掷出六点的行动者，就（在单纯意义上）能如此做。然而还存在另一种能力意义，它要求行动者在某种相关意义上处于控制之中（不过对此类意义是否存在，晚近有一项异议，见 Mandelkern 2024）[^mandelkern-2024]。Mele 把这种控制更强的意义上的能力称为意向能力。拥有意向能力需要对自身表现有多大的控制，这是有争议的。与前一分类一样，人们可以认为“单纯”与“意向”能力的概念指示的是一个梯度而非严格的二分：行动者对一项行动之施行的控制可多可少。

en: A third distinction worth mentioning, drawn by Vihvelin (2013), is that between *narrow* and *wide* abilities. Narrow abilities are abilities that agents possess in virtue of their internal constitution. Thus, two intrinsic duplicates (governed by the same laws) have the same narrow abilities. In contrast, wide abilities are abilities that agents possess in virtue of the combination of their internal constitution and their surroundings. On first sight, the narrow/wide distinction might appear to coincide with the distinction between general and specific abilities. In each case, one type of ability is possessed only if the agent has the opportunity to exercise it. However, Vihvelin proposes that an agent who lacks a narrow ability to *A* at a given time may nevertheless have a general ability to *A*. Such an agent may generally (at most other times) possess the narrow ability to *A*.
zh: 第三个值得一提的区分由 Vihvelin（2013）做出：** 窄 ** （narrow）能力与 ** 宽 ** （wide）能力之分。窄能力是行动者凭其内部构造而拥有的能力。于是，两个（受相同规律支配的）内在复本拥有相同的窄能力。相比之下，宽能力是行动者凭其内部构造与其周遭环境的组合而拥有的能力。乍看之下，窄/宽之分似乎与一般/特定之分重合：两种情形里，行动者拥有其中一类能力都需要有施行的机会。然而，Vihvelin 提出，在给定时刻缺乏实施 *A* 之窄能力的行动者，仍可以拥有实施 *A* 的一般能力；这样的行动者在大多数其他时刻一般拥有实施 *A* 的窄能力。

en: While many questions remain about the best way to carve up abilities, it should be clear that distinctions between different types or senses of ability are important not just in their own right, but also if we wish to explicate certain other phenomena by appeal to abilities. Abilities have been invoked to account for knowledge, concept possession, free will, disability, and other phenomena. If agents can possess more than one type of ability, or possess an ability in various senses, then carefully specifying which type or sense is relevant will be crucial to appropriately account for these other phenomena.
zh: 尽管关于如何切分能力仍有许多问题，但应当清楚：能力的不同类型或意义上的区分，不仅本身重要，而且在我们希望借能力来说明其他现象时同样重要。能力曾被用来解释知识、概念占有（concept possession）、自由意志、残疾及其他现象。如果行动者可以拥有不止一种类型的能力、或在不同意义上拥有能力，那么细致指明哪一类型或哪一意义相关，对恰当说明这些其他现象就至关重要。

en: 3. Hypothetical theories of ability
zh: 3 能力的假设式理论

en: The bulk of theories of ability that have been defended in the historical and contemporary literature have been what we might call *hypothetical* theories. On such views, to have an ability is for it to be the case that one *would* act in certain ways if one were to have certain volitions. One arrives at different theories depending on how one understands the volitions in question and how exactly these actions would hypothetically depend on them, but nonetheless these views constitute something like a unified family. Given their prominence and unity, it is natural to begin our survey of theories of ability with them.
zh: 历史与当代文献中得到辩护的能力理论，其主体是我们可称为 ** 假设式 ** （hypothetical）的理论。按这类看法，拥有一种能力，就是：如果一个人拥有某些意愿，她 ** 就会 ** 以某些方式行动。对相关意愿的不同理解、以及这些行动在假设上对意愿的依赖方式之不同，会产生不同的理论，但它们仍构成一个大致统一的家族。鉴于其突出地位与统一性，我们的能力理论综述从它们开始是自然的。

en: 3.1 The conditional analysis
zh: 3.1 条件句分析

en: The most prominent hypothetical theory of ability is what has come to be called the ‘conditional analysis’. In what follows, we will survey that form of analysis, the problems for it, and alternatives to it that are supposed to overcome those problems.
zh: 最突出的假设式能力理论，就是后来被称为“条件句分析”（conditional analysis）的那种。下文将综述这种分析的形式、它面临的问题、以及旨在克服那些问题的替代方案。

en: The conditional analysis of ability has at least two aspects. First, *S* has an ability to *A* just in case a certain conditional is true of her. Second, that conditional has the following form: *S* would *A* if *S* were to have a certain volition. The precise form such an analysis will take will depend on, first, how we interpret this conditional and, second, which volition figures in the antecedent.
zh: 能力的条件句分析至少有两个方面。第一，当且仅当某个条件句对 *S* 成立时，*S* 才拥有实施 *A* 的能力。第二，该条件句具有如下形式：** 如果 S 拥有某个意愿，S 就会实施 A**。这样一种分析的确切形式将取决于：其一，我们如何解读这个条件句；其二，前件中出现的是哪个意愿。

en: It has been standard in the literature, when this first question has been raised, to understand the conditional as a *subjunctive* conditional (Ginet 1980)[^ginet-1980], and we will assume in what follows that this is the best form of the conditional analysis. There has been some disagreement about whether it is a *might* or a *would* conditional that is relevant (for an account of this distinction, see Lewis 1973, 21–24)[^lewis-1973], as well as about which volition is relevant. In the following, we will take the relevant conditional to be a *would* conditional, and the relevant volition to be *trying*, though nothing will hang on these selections, and the points to be raised would apply also to other forms of conditional analysis, *mutatis mutandis*.
zh: 文献中的标准做法，是把这个条件句理解为 ** 虚拟 ** 条件句（subjunctive conditional）（Ginet 1980）[^ginet-1980]；下文我们将假定这是条件句分析的最好形式。相关的究竟是 *might* 条件句还是 *would* 条件句（关于这一区分的说明见 Lewis 1973, 21–24）[^lewis-1973]，以及哪个意愿相关，对此一直有分歧。下文我们取相关条件句为 *would* 条件句、相关意愿为 ** 尝试 ** （trying）；不过这些选择无关宏旨，将要提出的那几点经适当变通后也适用于其他形式的条件句分析。

en: We thus arrive at the following form of the conditional analysis:
zh: 于是我们得到条件句分析的如下形式：

en: *S* has the ability to *A* iff *S* would *A* if *S* tried to *A*.
zh: *S* 拥有实施 *A* 的能力，当且仅当：若 *S* 尝试实施 *A*，则 *S* 会实施 *A*。

en: If (CA) were true, it would constitute a theory of ability in that it would say under exactly what conditions some agent has the ability to perform some action without making reference to the idea of ability itself.
zh: 如果 (CA) 为真，它将构成一种能力理论：它将不诉诸能力观念本身，而径直说出在何种确切条件下某行动者拥有实施某行动的能力。

en: The conditional analysis so understood has been subject to a fair amount of criticism, which will be reviewed in the following section. It bears noting, however, just how apt an account of ability it seems at first pass. It satisfies, at least at first approximation, the extensional constraints: there are many actions with respect to which a typical agent satisfies the relevant conditional, and also many actions with respect to which she does not, and these roughly correspond to her abilities. This imposes a demand even on those who wish to reject (CA), namely to explain *why*, if (CA) is simply false, it so closely approximates to the truth about abilities.
zh: 如此理解的条件句分析已受到相当多的批评，下一节将予以回顾。然而值得注意的是，初看之下它作为能力说明是多么贴切。它至少在初步近似上满足外延约束：对许多行动，一个典型行动者满足相关条件句；对另许多行动则不满足；而这两组行动大致对应于她的诸能力。这甚至对那些想拒绝 (CA) 的人也构成一项要求，即说明：如果 (CA) 简直是假的，为什么它如此接近关于能力的真理。

en: Its approximate satisfaction of the extensional constraints is also plausibly a reason why something like (CA) has found so many thoughtful advocates. It is at least strongly suggested, for example, by the following remarks from Hume’s *Enquiry*:
zh: (CA) 之外延约束的近似满足，或许也说明了为什么类似 (CA) 的东西找到了那么多深思熟虑的拥护者。例如，休谟《人类理解研究》中的以下段落至少强烈地提示了它：

en: For what is meant by liberty, when applied to voluntary actions? We cannot surely mean that actions have so little connexion with motives, inclinations, and circumstances, that one does not follow with a certain degree of uniformity from the other, and that one affords no inference by which we can conclude the existence of the other. For these are plain and acknowledged matters of fact. By liberty, then, we can only mean a power of acting or not acting, according to the determinations of the will; this is, if we choose to remain at rest, we may; if we choose to move, we also may. Now this hypothetical liberty is universally allowed to belong to every one who is not a prisoner and in chains. (8.1; Hume 1748, 72)[^hume-1748]
zh: 所谓应用于自愿行动的自由，究竟是什么意思呢？我们肯定不是说，行动与动机、倾向和处境之间的联结如此之少，以致一个不能以某种程度的齐一性从另一个跟随而来，一个也不能提供任何推断，使我们得以推断另一个的存在；因为这些是明白而公认的事实。那么，所谓自由，我们只能是指按照意志的决定去行动或不行动的力；也就是说，如果我们选择保持静止，我们可以这样做；如果我们选择移动，我们也可以这样做。这种假设的自由，通常被认为属于每一个不是戴枷锁的囚徒的人。（8.1；Hume 1748, 72）[^hume-1748]

en: Of course, Hume and many of those who have followed him have been attempting to do something rather *more* than to offer a theory of ability. Hume’s intent was to show that disputes over ‘question of liberty and necessity, the most contentious question of metaphysics’ have been ‘merely verbal’ (8.1; Hume 1748, 72)[^hume-1748]. Whatever we may think of this striking claim, however, there is a dialectical gap between it and the alleged truth of (CA). To anticipate a theme that will be central in what follows, we must be careful to distinguish between, on the one hand, the adequacy of various views of ability and, on the other, the more contentious metaphysical questions about freedom to which they are doubtlessly related. It is the former that will be our concern in this section.
zh: 当然，休谟以及追随他的许多人试图做的，远不止给出一种能力理论。休谟的意图是表明：关于“自由与必然的问题——形而上学中最起争执的问题”的争论“纯属语词之争”（8.1；Hume 1748, 72）[^hume-1748]。无论我们如何看待这个惊人的主张，它与 (CA) 之为真这一说法之间都存在一个辩证的落差。预演下文的一个中心主题：我们必须小心区分，一方面是各种能力看法的得当与否，另一方面是与它们无疑相关的关于自由的更起争执的形而上学问题。本节关心的将是前者。

en: 3.2 Problems for the conditional analysis
zh: 3.2 条件句分析面临的问题

en: (CA) says that satisfying a certain conditional is both sufficient and necessary for having a certain ability. There are two kinds of counterexamples that may be brought against (CA): counterexamples to its sufficiency, and to its necessity. Let us take these in turn.
zh: (CA) 说，满足某个条件句既是拥有某种能力的充分条件也是必要条件。可以针对 (CA) 提出两类反例：针对其充分性的反例与针对其必要性的反例。让我们依次来看。

en: Counterexamples to the *sufficiency* of (CA) have been most prominent in the literature. Informally, they are suggested by the question: ‘but could *S* try to *A*?’ There are a variety of ways of translating this rhetorical question into a counterexample. We may distinguish two: global counterexamples, according to which (CA) might *always* get the facts about ability wrong, and local counterexamples, according to which (CA) might *sometimes* get the facts about ability wrong.
zh: (CA) ** 充分性 ** 的反例在文献中最为突出。非正式地说，它们由这样一个问题引出：“可是 *S* 能尝试实施 *A* 吗？”把这个反问转化为反例的方式多种多样。我们可以区分两种：全局反例——(CA) 可能 ** 总是 ** 弄错关于能力的事实；局部反例——(CA) 可能 ** 有时 ** 弄错关于能力的事实。

en: Begin with global counterexamples. Let us say that *determinism* is true at our world. Familiar arguments purport to show that, if this is the case, then no one has the ability to do anything, except perhaps for what she actually does. But if (CA) is true, then agents would have the ability to perform various actions that they do not actually perform. This is a counterexample turning on precisely the kinds of contentious questions about free will and determinism that, as indicated above, we are for the moment setting aside. (We will return to the issues purportedly raised by determinism below in Section 5.1).
zh: 先看全局反例。让我们假定 ** 决定论 ** 在我们的世界为真。人们熟知的论证旨在表明：如果情形如此，那么没有人拥有做任何事的能力——也许除了她实际做的事。但如果 (CA) 为真，行动者就会拥有实施各种他们并不实际实施之行动的能力。这正是一个围绕自由意志与决定论之争议问题的反例；如上所述，这些问题我们暂时搁置（第 5.1 节将回到决定论据称引出的问题）。

en: It seems, however, that we can show that (CA) is false even relative to premises that are shared between various disputants in the free will debates. This is what is shown by local counterexamples to (CA). One such example is given by Keith Lehrer:
zh: 然而，即使相对于自由意志论辩各方共同接受的前提，我们似乎也能表明 (CA) 为假。这正是 (CA) 的局部反例所表明的。Keith Lehrer 给出了这样一个例子：

en: Suppose that I am offered a bowl of candy and in the bowl are small round red sugar balls. I do not choose to take one of the red sugar balls because I have a pathological aversion to such candy. (Perhaps they remind me of drops of blood and … ) It is logically consistent to suppose that if I had chosen to take the red sugar ball, I would have taken one, but, not so choosing, I am utterly unable to touch one. (Lehrer 1968, 32)[^lehrer-1968]
zh: 设想有人递给我一碗糖果，碗里有小的圆形红色糖球。我没有选择拿一颗红糖球，因为我对此类糖果有病态的厌恶（也许它们使我想起血滴，以及……）。假定“如果我当初选择拿红糖球，我就会拿一颗”在逻辑上融贯；但由于没有如此选择，我完全无法触碰一颗。（Lehrer 1968, 32）[^lehrer-1968]

en: Such an example shows that (CA) is false without assuming anything contentious in debates over freedom. It turns rather on a simple point: that psychological shortcomings, just as much as external impediments, may undermine abilities. (CA), which does not recognize this point, is therefore subject to counterexamples where such psychological shortcomings become relevant. We may, if we like, distinguish ‘psychological’ from ‘non-psychological’ ability, and claim that (CA) correctly accounts for the latter (this sort of strategy is suggested, for example, by Albritton 1985)[^albritton-1985]. But our ordinary notion of ability, that of which we are attempting to give a theory, seems to involve *both* psychological and non-psychological requirements. And if that is correct, then Lehrer’s example succeeds as a counterexample to (CA) as a theory of our ordinary notion of ability.
zh: 这样一个例子表明 (CA) 为假，而无须假定任何关于自由的争议前提。它所依据的只是一点：心理上的欠缺与外在障碍一样，可以破坏能力。(CA) 不承认这一点，因此在心理欠缺成为相关因素的场合会遭遇反例。我们愿意的话，可以区分“心理的”与“非心理的”能力，并主张 (CA) 恰当地说明了后者（这类策略如 Albritton 1985 所提示）[^albritton-1985]。但我们试图给出理论的那个日常能力概念，似乎同时涉及 ** 心理的 ** 与 ** 非心理的 ** 两重要求。如果确实如此，那么作为我们日常能力概念的理论，(CA) 就会在 Lehrer 的例子面前失手。

en: Counterexamples to the *necessity* of (CA) have been less frequently discussed (though see Wolf 1990)[^wolf-1990], but they also raise important issues about ability. Consider a case where a good golfer misses an easy putt. Given that this golfer tried to make the putt and failed to, it is false that she would have made the putt if she had tried to; after all, she *did* try it and did not make it. But, as a good golfer, she presumably had the ability to make the putt. So this seems to be a case where one can have an ability without satisfying the relevant conditional, and hence a counterexample to the necessity of (CA).
zh: (CA) ** 必要性 ** 的反例讨论得较少（但见 Wolf 1990）[^wolf-1990]，不过它们同样引出关于能力的重要问题。设想一位好高尔夫球手错过了一次轻推入洞。既然这位球手尝试了这次推杆而未成功，那么“如果她尝试推杆她就会打进”便为假——毕竟她 ** 确实 ** 尝试了而没有打进。但作为好球手，她想必拥有打进这次推杆的能力。于是这似乎是一个拥有能力却不满足相关条件句的情形，因而是 (CA) 必要性的反例。

en: Here the defender of (CA) might avail herself of the distinction between specific and general abilities. (CA), she might say, is an account of what it is to have a specific ability: that is, to actually be in a position to perform an action. The golfer *does* lack this ability in this case, as (CA) correctly predicts. It is nonetheless true that the golfer has the *general* ability to sink putts like this. But (CA) does not purport to be an analysis of general ability, and as such is compatible with the golfer having that sort of ability (an approach very much like this is suggested in Locke 1962)[^locke-1962]. Again, the plausibility of this response will hang on the viability of the distinction between specific and general abilities. And, whatever the merits of this response, the objection to the sufficiency of (CA) remains.
zh: 这里 (CA) 的辩护者可以求助于特定与一般能力之分。她可以说：(CA) 说明的是拥有特定能力是怎么回事——即真正处于能实施一项行动的位置。在这个例子里，这位球手确实缺乏这种能力，而 (CA) 正确地预言了这一点。尽管如此，这位球手拥有打进这类推杆的 ** 一般能力 ** 仍是真的。但 (CA) 并不自称是一般能力的分析，因此与球手拥有那种能力相容（Locke 1962 提出了与此非常相似的进路）[^locke-1962]。同样，这一回应是否成立，取决于特定与一般能力之分能否站得住。而且，无论这一回应有何优点，(CA) 充分性方面的异议依然存在。

en: We appear to be at an impasse. On the one hand, the thought that abilities are in some sense hypothetical is a deep and persistent theme in historical and contemporary work on ability. On the other hand, the simplest development of this thought — the conditional analysis (CA) — appears to face obvious and well-known counterexamples both to its sufficiency and necessity, even when we waive the global counterexamples raised by determinism. Which way to go? We might reject the idea that abilities admit of a conditional analysis. Or we might give a somewhat more sophisticated conditional analysis.
zh: 我们似乎陷入了僵局。一方面，“能力在某种意义上是假设式的”这一想法，在历史与当代的能力研究中都是深刻而持久的主题。另一方面，这一想法最简单的发展——条件句分析 (CA)——面临着其充分性与必要性两方面显而易见、众所周知的反例，即使我们暂不考虑决定论引出的全局反例。路在何方？我们可以拒绝能力容许条件句分析的想法；也可以给出一个多少更精致的条件句分析。

en: 3.3 Sophisticated conditional accounts
zh: 3.3 精致化的条件句说明

en: How might the conditional analysis of ability be made more sophisticated? Since the conditional analysis is a conditional that involves a volition, there are at least two ways one might do this. First, one might be more sophisticated about the nature of the volition: why do we focus on *trying*? Second, one might be more sophisticated about the conditional: what precisely are the semantics of this conditional?
zh: 条件句分析可以怎样变得更精致？既然条件句分析是涉及意愿的条件句，至少有两条路可走。第一，对意愿的本性更精致些：我们为什么聚焦于 ** 尝试 **？第二，对条件句本身更精致些：这个条件句的语义究竟是什么？

en: Donald Davidson takes the first way, and identifies the choice of volition in a traditional conditional analysis as the culprit:
zh: 唐纳德·戴维森走第一条路，把传统条件句分析中对意愿的挑选点名为祸首：

en: The antecedent of a causal conditional that attempts to analyze ‘can’ or ‘could’ or ‘free to’ must not contain, as its dominant verb, a verb of action, or any verb which makes sense of the question, Can someone do *it*? (Davidson 1973, 68)[^davidson-1973]
zh: 一个试图分析“能够”（can）或“could”或“有自由去做”的因果条件句，其前件的主导动词不得是行动动词，也不得是任何使“人能做 ** 它 ** 吗”这一问题有意义的动词。（Davidson 1973, 68）[^davidson-1973]

en: Davidson suggests that we may overcome this difficulty at least by endorsing:
zh: 戴维森提出，至少可以通过认可如下命题来克服这一困难：

en: *A* can do *x* intentionally (under the description *d*) means that if *A* has desires and beliefs that rationalize *x* (under *d*), then *A* does *x*. (Davidson 1973, 68)[^davidson-1973]
zh: *A* 能有意地做 *x*（按描述 *d*），意思是：如果 *A* 拥有使 *x*（按 *d*）合理化的欲望与信念，那么 *A* 就做 *x*。（Davidson 1973, 68）[^davidson-1973]

en: But it is not clear that Davidson’s revision in fact answers objections to the sufficiency of the traditional conditional analysis. For these objections did not essentially depend on a verb of action figuring in the antecedent of the analyzing conditional. Consider Lehrer’s case again. It seems true that *if* Lehrer’s imagined agent has desires and beliefs that rationalized that action under the description ‘eating a red candy’—namely, adopting the analysis of Davidson 1963, a desire for a red candy and a belief that this action is a way of eating a red candy—she would eat a red candy. But the trouble is precisely that, in virtue of her psychological disability, she is incapable of having this desire, and so cannot perform this action intentionally. *Pace* Davidson, the traditional objection to the conditional analysis seems to turn not on the specific volition selected but rather on the very idea that ability is to be understood in terms of a simple conditional dependence of action on the will.
zh: 但戴维森的修正是否真的回应了针对传统条件句分析充分性的异议，并不清楚。因为那些异议并不本质上依赖分析条件句前件中出现行动动词。再考虑 Lehrer 的情形。事情似乎是真的：** 如果 ** Lehrer 设想的行动者拥有使“吃一颗红色糖果”这一行动（按该描述）合理化的欲望与信念——即按 Davidson 1963 的分析，即拥有对红色糖果的欲望以及“该行动是吃红色糖果的一种方式”的信念——她就会吃下一颗红色糖果。但麻烦恰恰在于：由于她的心理残疾，她不可能拥有这种欲望，因而不能有意地实施这一行动。*Pace* 戴维森：针对条件句分析的传统异议，似乎并不取决于挑选了哪个具体意愿，而取决于“能力应被理解为行动对意志的简单条件句依赖”这一观念本身。

en: This brings us to a second way of responding, which is to suggest that ability instead involves a sophisticated conditional dependence of action on the will. To begin to develop this kind of approach, we can ask: what kind of conditional is at issue in CA? Though this point is not always explicitly recognized, this conditional is a subjunctive or counterfactual conditional: it concerns what *would* happen if an agent *were* to try. Much of the canonical literature on the conditional analysis antedates adequate semantics theories of the counterfactual, notably the Stalnaker-Lewis semantics (Stalnaker, 1968; Lewis 1973)[^lewis-1973]. In this way, many of the authors in the tradition do not even have the formal resources to explore this second way of responding.
zh: 这就引出第二条回应之路：能力涉及的其实是行动对意志的 ** 精致 ** 条件句依赖。为发展这类进路，我们可以问：CA 中涉及的是哪一类条件句？这一点虽不总是被明说，但这个条件句是虚拟条件句或反事实条件句：它关心的是，如果行动者 ** 要去 ** 尝试，** 会 ** 发生什么。条件句分析的大量经典文献都早于反事实条件句的成熟语义理论，尤其是 Stalnaker-Lewis 语义学（Stalnaker, 1968; Lewis 1973）[^lewis-1973]。正因如此，这一传统中的许多作者甚至不具备探讨第二条回应之路所需的形式资源。

en: One recent work that addresses these formal questions is (Mandelkern et al. 2017)[^mandelkern-2017]. This discussion proposes an ‘act conditional analysis’ (ACA) on which an agent *S* is able to perform some act *A* just in case “there is some practically available action such that if *S* tries to do it, she does *A*” (Mandelkern et al. 2017, 314)[^mandelkern-2017]. The (ACA) revises the conditional analysis (CA) by introducing a layer of existential quantification over modality, and introduces a welcome degree of formal sophistication into the discussion of ability claims. For present purposes, however, it bears noting that the authors do not propose to give a reductive account of what it is for an act to be “practically available”, although this is an agentive and indeed abilitative notion (Mandelkern et al. 2017, 318)[^mandelkern-2017]. In virtue of what is choosing a candy practically available to me, but not to the agent described by Lehrer? The authors do not purport to answer the question, but in this sense their proposal remains incomplete as a theory of ability.
zh: 处理这些形式问题的一部晚近著作是 Mandelkern 等（2017）[^mandelkern-2017]。该讨论提出了“行动条件句分析”（act conditional analysis，ACA）：行动者 *S* 能实施某行动 *A*，当且仅当“存在某个实践上可得的行动，使得若 *S* 尝试做它，她就会做 *A*”（Mandelkern et al. 2017, 314）[^mandelkern-2017]。(ACA) 通过在模态上引入一层存在量化修订了条件句分析 (CA)，为能力断言的讨论引入了可喜的形式精致度。但就本文而言，值得注意：两位作者并未打算给出“一个行动是实践上可得的”究竟是怎么回事的还原说明，尽管这是一个行动者性的、乃至能力性的概念（Mandelkern et al. 2017, 318）[^mandelkern-2017]。凭什么是“挑一颗糖果”对我而言实践上可得，而对 Lehrer 所描写的行动者不可得？作者并不打算回答这个问题；就此而言，他们的提案作为能力理论仍不完整。

en: Whatever the prospects for this particular proposal, there is a broader methodological point here that ramifies well beyond (CA), and indeed beyond the prospects for a conditional analysis of ability more generally. Any account of abilities owes us, among other things, an account of ability-ascriptions. This is perhaps true of philosophical topics generally, but it is true or ability in particular. Even philosophers who are explicit in their “refusal to take language as a starting point in the analysis of thought and modality” (Lewis 1983, xi)[^lewis-1983] are prone to make explicit appeal to language when the topic turns to ability, as occurs in (Lewis 1976)[^lewis-1976] or (Taylor 1960)[^taylor-1960]. When it comes to ability, it is difficult to even identify the topic under consideration without using or mentioning certain phrases, notably ‘can’ and ‘is able to’.
zh: 无论这个特定提案前景如何，这里有一个更广的方法论要点，其影响远超 (CA)，也远超能力之条件句分析的前景。任何能力说明都欠我们一项能力归属（ability-ascriptions）的说明。这对哲学论题或许普遍成立，但对能力尤其成立。就连那些明确“拒绝把语言当作分析思想与模态的起点”的哲学家（Lewis 1983, xi）[^lewis-1983]，当话题转向能力时也倾向于明确诉诸语言，如 Lewis（1976）[^lewis-1976]或 Taylor（1960）[^taylor-1960]。谈到能力时，若不使用或提及某些短语——尤其是“能（can）”与“能够（is able to）”——我们甚至难以确定所考虑的论题是什么。

en: Happily, our understanding of such phrases is steadily improving. While there has long been considerable philosophical interest in expressions such as ‘can’ and ‘is able to’, there is nothing recognizable as a rigorous semantic theory of such terms prior to the foundational work of Angelika Kratzer, recently revised and collected in (Kratzer 2012)[^kratzer-2012]. Kratzer’s work has been central to natural language semantics, and its significance for philosophical work is still being appreciated. We address the question of whether Kratzer’s semantics might inform a theory of ability in Section 4, where we consider the modal analysis of ability. Here we simply note that the question of whether Kratzer’s account is correct as a theory of agentive modals remains an open one. Any adequate account of ability can be expected to give an account of ability ascriptions, and therefore needs to attend to this ongoing debate in the semantics of modal expressions.
zh: 可喜的是，我们对这类短语的理解在稳步改善。尽管“能”与“能够”这类表达长久以来有相当的哲学关注，但在 Angelika Kratzer 的奠基性工作（最近修订并结集为 Kratzer 2012）[^kratzer-2012]之前，并不存在称得上严格语义理论的东西。Kratzer 的工作对自然语言语义学至关重要，其对哲学工作的意义至今仍在被消化。Kratzer 的语义学能否为一套能力理论提供养分，这个问题我们将在第 4 节——考察能力的模态分析时——处理。这里我们仅指出：Kratzer 的说明作为行动者模态词（agentive modals）的理论是否正确，仍是悬而未决的。任何足够的能力说明都可望给出能力归属的说明，因此需要关注模态表达词语义学的这场进行中的争论。

en: 3.4 Alternative hypothetical accounts
zh: 3.4 其他假设式说明

en: If we reject a conditional analysis of ability, we might still give an account of ability that is broadly ‘hypothetical’ in Hume’s sense. The guiding idea of hypothetical accounts of ability is that there is a certain internal relationship between ability and volition, and that this relationship involves a certain kind of dependence. The guiding idea, we might say, is that what it is to have an ability to *A* is for one’s *A*’ing to depend mostly or entirely on one’s volitions with respect to *A*. The conditional analysis (CA) formalizes this insight in a simple way, but it is not the only way in which this might be done.
zh: 如果我们拒绝能力的条件句分析，我们仍可能给出一种在休谟意义上广义“假设式”的能力说明。假设式能力说明的指导观念是：能力与意愿之间存在某种内在关系，而这种关系涉及某种依赖。我们可以说，指导观念是：拥有实施 *A* 的能力是怎么回事，取决于一个人的实施 *A* 之举在多大或全部程度上依赖于他关于 *A* 的意愿。条件句分析 (CA) 以简单的方式把这一洞见形式化，但这样做的方式并非只有一种。

en: Several authors have revisited the thought that we may give a broadly hypothetical account of ability, without endorsing the problematic claim (CA). This is the view of ability that has been defended by Smith (2003), Vihvelin (2004, 2013), and Fara (2008). Following Clarke (2009), we may label this view as the “new dispositionalism”.
zh: 好几位作者重新考察了“可以给出广义假设式的能力说明而不必背书有缺陷的 (CA)”这一想法。这就是 Smith（2003）、Vihvelin（2004, 2013）与 Fara（2008）所辩护的能力观。循 Clarke（2009），我们可以把这个观点称作“新倾向主义”（new dispositionalism）。

en: What unifies the new dispositionalists is that they return to the conditional analysis of ability in light of two thoughts. The first thought is one already noted: that there is a variety of power, dispositions, that is similar in many respects to abilities. The second thought is that there are well-known problems of giving a conditional analysis of dispositions, in light of which many authors have been inclined to reject the long-assumed link between dispositions and conditionals. Taken together, these thoughts yield a promising new line on abilities: that though we ought to reject the conditional analysis of abilities, we may yet defend a dispositional account of abilities.
zh: 新倾向主义者的共同点，是他们在两个想法的启发下回到了能力的条件句分析。第一个想法前已提及：存在一种力——倾向——它在许多方面与能力相似。第二个想法是：为倾向给出条件句分析存在众所周知的问题，鉴于此，许多作者倾向于拒绝倾向与条件句之间久已被假定的联结。合起来，这两个想法为能力开辟了一条有希望的新路：虽然我们应当拒绝能力的条件句分析，但我们仍可为能力辩护一种倾向式说明。

en: Why ought we reject the conditional analysis of dispositions? Consider the following analysis of the disposition to break when struck:
zh: 为什么我们应当拒绝倾向的条件句分析？考虑对“被撞即碎”倾向的如下分析：

en: *x* is disposed to break when struck iff *x* would break if *x* were struck.
zh: *x* 倾向于在被撞时破碎，当且仅当：若 *x* 被撞，则 *x* 会破碎。

en: Despite the intuitive appeal of (CD), there appear to be at least two kinds of counterexamples to it. First, consider a crystal glass that, if it were about to be struck, would transform into steel. This glass is disposed to break when struck, but it is not true that it would break if struck — the transformation renders this false. This is a case of finking, in the language of Martin (1994). Second, consider a crystal glass stuffed with styrofoam packaging. This glass is disposed to break when struck, but it is not true that it would break if struck — the packaging prevents this. This is a case of masking, in the language of Johnston (1992). In light of such cases, it seems we ought to reject (CD).
zh: 尽管 (CD) 直观上有吸引力，看起来至少存在两类反例。第一，设想一只水晶杯，如果它即将被撞，它就会变成钢。这只杯子倾向于被撞即碎，但“如果它被撞它就会碎”并不为真——变身使之为假。这是 Martin（1994）术语中的 fink 情形。第二，设想一只塞满泡沫塑料包装的水晶杯。这只杯子倾向于被撞即碎，但“如果它被撞它就会碎”并不为真——包装阻止了这一点。这是 Johnston（1992）所说的掩蔽（masking）情形。鉴于此类情形，我们似乎应当拒绝 (CD)。

en: The bearing of these points on our earlier discussion of the conditional analysis is the following. There appear to be quite general problems for giving a conditional analysis of powers. So it may be that the failures of the conditional analysis of ability were not due to any fact about abilities, but rather to a shortcoming of conditional analyses generally. One way of overcoming this problem, if this diagnosis is correct, is to analyze abilities directly in terms of dispositions.
zh: 这些要点与我们先前关于条件句分析的讨论的关联如下：为诸力给出条件句分析，看来存在相当一般性的问题。因此，能力之条件句分析的失败，可能并非源于关于能力的任何事实，而是一般条件句分析的一个短处。如果这一诊断正确，克服该问题的一条路，就是直接以倾向来分析能力。

en: Such an analysis is proposed by Fara (2008), who argues:
zh: Fara（2008）提出了这样一种分析，他论证：

en: *S* has the ability to *A* in circumstances *C* iff she has the disposition to *A* when, in circumstances *C*, she tries to *A*. (Fara 2008, 848)[^fara-2008]
zh: *S* 在境况 *C* 中拥有实施 *A* 的能力，当且仅当：她拥有这样的倾向——在境况 *C* 中当其尝试实施 *A* 时实施 *A*。（Fara 2008, 848）[^fara-2008]

en: The similarity of this analysis to the conditional analysis (CA) is clear. (Note that other new dispositionalists, notably Vihvelin and Smith, are sympathetic with the idea that conditionals do in the end have a central if complicated role to play in the analysis of dispositions, so their departure from (CA) is in a way less radical than Fara’s.) This raises several immediate questions, such as whether this analysis can overcome the problem of sufficiency that plagued those approaches (see Fara 2008, 851–852 for an affirmative answer, and Clarke 2009, 334–336 for some doubts)[^clarke-2009][^fara-2008]. But a larger question looms, which is whether the abilities of agents can indeed be analogized to the dispositions of objects.
zh: 这一分析与条件句分析 (CA) 的相似显而易见。（注意，其他新倾向主义者——尤其是 Vihvelin 与 Smith——同情这样一种想法：条件句终究在倾向分析中扮演核心而复杂的角色，所以他们与 (CA) 的决裂在某种意义上不如 Fara 激进。）这立刻引出几个问题，例如：这一分析能否克服困扰先前那些进路的充分性问题（Fara 2008, 851–852 给出肯定回答；Clarke 2009, 334–336 表示一些怀疑）[^clarke-2009][^fara-2008]。但一个更大的问题迫近：行动者的能力究竟是否可以类推于对象的倾向。

en: One way of bringing out what is missing is by appeal to the idea that there seems to be a connection between my abilities, in the sense of ability that is relevant to free will, and what is up to me. Clarke claims that this sort of connection fails on the new dispositionalist view of ability:
zh: 一种呈现缺失的方式，是诉诸这样一个想法：我的能力（在与自由意志相关的意义上的能力）与“什么事由我做主”之间似乎存在一种联系。Clarke 主张，在新倾向主义的能力观下这种联系会失效：

en: Although the presence of a fink or mask that would prevent one’s *A*ing is compatible with having a general capacity (the unimpaired competence to *A*), there is an ordinary sense in which in such circumstances an agent might well be unable to *A* …. If there is something in place that would prevent me from *A*ing should I try to *A*, if it is not up to me that it would so prevent me, and it it is not up to me that such a thing is in place, then even if I have a capacity to *A*, it is not up to me whether I exercise that capacity. (Clarke 2009, 339)[^clarke-2009]
zh: 虽然阻止你实施 *A* 的 fink 或掩蔽之在场，与拥有一般资质（实施 *A* 的完好胜任力）相容，但在这样的处境下，行动者很可能无法实施 *A*，这在通常意义上是成立的……如果有某种东西已经就位，会在我尝试实施 *A* 时阻止我；如果它如此阻止我并非由我做主；如果这种东西就位也并非由我做主——那么即使我拥有实施 *A* 的资质，我是否施行这一资质也并非由我做主。（Clarke 2009, 339）[^clarke-2009]

en: Thus the objection is that, while the new dispositionalist has perhaps offered a theory of something, it is not a theory of ability.
zh: 于是异议是：新倾向主义者或许给出了关于某种东西的理论，但它不是关于能力的理论。

en: How should the new dispositionalist respond? One thought is that we are here again encountering the distinction between general and specific abilities. The new dispositionalist might contend that, while the agent described by Clarke lacks the specific ability to do otherwise, she has the general ability to do otherwise, and that it is this general ability of which the new dispositionalist is giving an account.
zh: 新倾向主义者该如何回应？一种想法是：我们在此再次遭遇到一般与特定能力之分。新倾向主义者可以主张：Clarke 所描写的行动者虽缺乏“另做他事”的特定能力，却拥有“另做他事”的一般能力，而新倾向主义给出的正是关于这种一般能力的说明。

en: Other important recent work has pursued the resources for a broadly hypothetical account of ability in new ways. Notable here is (Jaster 2020)[^jaster-2020], who defends a “success view” of abilities, which in a simplified version holds:
zh: 另一些重要的晚近工作以新的方式开发着广义假设式能力说明的资源。值得注意的有 Jaster（2020）[^jaster-2020]，她为能力的一种“成功观”辩护，其简化版本主张：

en: *S* has an agentive ability to *A* if and only if *S* *A*’s in a sufficiently high proportion of the relevant possible situations in which she intends to *A*.
zh: *S* 拥有实施 *A* 的行动者能力，当且仅当：在她意图实施 *A* 的相关可能情境中，*S* 以足够高的比例实施 *A*。

en: Jaster’s analysis is non-conditional but is nonetheless hypothetical in the broader sense suggested here. It does not identify abilities with dispositions, though it shares formal features with certain treatments of disposition ascriptions, notably, as Jaster notes, that of (Manley and Wasserman 2008)[^manley-2008]. Along with the other work cited above, it suggests that the development of some kind of broadly hypothetical analysis of ability remains a lively and open research program.
zh: Jaster 的分析是非条件句的，但仍属于此处广义的假设式说明。它不把能力等同于倾向，尽管它与倾向归属的某些处理共享形式特征——正如 Jaster 指出的，尤其与 Manley 与 Wasserman（2008）的处理相似[^manley-2008]。与上述其他工作一道，它表明：发展某种广义假设式的能力分析，仍是一个活跃而开放的研究纲领。

en: 4. Non-hypothetical theories of ability
zh: 4 非假设式的能力理论

en: A second broad family of theories of ability is *non-hypothetical*. Proponents of non-hypothetical accounts reject the idea that ability is best characterized in terms of a link between an agent’s volitions and actions. The most established non-hypothetical account, especially within the logic and linguistics literature, is the *modal analysis* of ability. According to the modal analysis, ability claims are possibility claims: claims about what an agent does in some non-actual state of affairs (or ‘possible world’). We discuss the modal analysis and some of the challenges it faces in detail below. Besides the modal analysis, there is a further class of non-hypothetical theories that has come to receive increasing attention. Theories in this class differ from the modal analysis in that they do not take ability to be straightforwardly analysable in terms of what an agent does in some other possible world. We turn to this new class of non-hypothetical analyses in §4.4.
zh: 能力理论的第二个大家族是 ** 非假设式的 **。非假设式说明的拥护者拒绝“能力最好以行动者意愿与行动之间的联结来刻画”这一想法。最成熟的非假设式说明——尤其在逻辑学与语言学文献中——是能力的 ** 模态分析 ** （modal analysis）。按模态分析，能力断言是可能性断言：关于行动者在某个非现实的情形（或“可能世界”）中做什么的断言。下文详细讨论模态分析及其面临的若干挑战。除模态分析外，还有一类日益受到关注的非假设式理论。这一类的理论与模态分析的不同在于：它们不把能力视作可以用“行动者在某个其他可能世界中做什么”来直接分析的东西。这一新的非假设式分析类，我们将在 §4.4 转到。

en: 4.1 The modal analysis
zh: 4.1 模态分析

en: Intuitively, claims about ability are tightly connected to claims about possibility. It is in some sense a truism that someone is able to perform some act just in case it is possible for her to perform it.
zh: 直观上，关于能力的断言与关于可能性的断言紧密相连。“某人能实施某行动，当且仅当她实施它是可能的”——在某种意义上这是一条自明之理。

en: To develop this purported truism, begin with the thought that for *S* to have an ability to *A* it is necessary, but not sufficient, that it be possible that *S* does *A*. This claim will be contentious for various more specialized sorts of possibility, such as *nomic* possibility or *practical* possibility. But if we may help ourselves to the idea of possibility *simpliciter* (‘metaphysical possibility’), then this claim appears plausible. (We will survey some challenges to it below in Section 4.2.) In contrast, it seems implausible that this sort of possibility is a sufficient condition: there are any number of acts that that are metaphysically possible to perform that an agent might nonetheless not be able to perform.
zh: 为发展这条疑似自明之理，从如下想法开始：*S* 拥有实施 *A* 的能力，其必要而非充分的条件是：*S* 实施 *A* 是可能的。这个主张对一些更专门的可能样态——如 ** 律则 ** 可能性或 ** 实践 ** 可能性——将是有争议的。但如果我们求助于单纯的可能性（“形而上学可能性”），这个主张看上去就讲得通（第 4.2 节将综述对它的若干挑战）。相比之下，这种可能性作为充分条件则站不住：有无数行动，实施它们在形而上学上是可能的，而行动者却可能无法实施。

en: This suggests a natural hypothesis. To have an ability to *A* is for it to be possible to *A* in some *restricted* sense of possibility. As nomic possibility is possibility relative to the laws of nature, and epistemic possibility is possibility relative to what an agent knows, so may ability be possibility relative to some independently specifiable set of conditions.
zh: 这提示出一个自然的假设：拥有实施 *A* 的能力，就是在某种 ** 受限 ** 的可能性意义上实施 *A* 是可能的。正如律则可能性是相对于自然律的可能性、认知可能性是相对于行动者所知的可能性，能力也可以是相对于某个可独立刻画的条件集的可能性。

en: To render this hypothesis precisely, we may employ the formal framework of ‘possible worlds,’ which offers an elegant and powerful semantics for modal language. On this framework, a proposition is possible just in case it is true at some possible world. We can then say an agent is able to *A* just in case she *A*’s at some world (or set of worlds) that satisfy some independently specifiable set of conditions.
zh: 为把这一假设表达得精确，我们可以借用“可能世界”的形式框架——它为模态语言提供了一套优雅而有力的语义学。在这个框架上，一个命题是可能的，当且仅当它在某个可能世界为真。于是我们可以说：行动者能实施 *A*，当且仅当她在某个（或某组）满足某个可独立刻画的条件集的世界实施 *A*。

en: We thus arrive at the modal analysis of ability:
zh: 于是我们得到能力的模态分析：

en: *S* has the ability to *A* iff *S* does *A* at some world (or set of worlds) satisfying condition *C*.
zh: *S* 拥有实施 *A* 的能力，当且仅当：*S* 在某个满足条件 *C* 的世界（或世界组）实施 *A*。

en: (MA) is actually not itself an analysis but rather a template for a general family of analyses. Different members of this family will be distinguished by the different candidates they might propose for *C*, as well as whether they quantify over individual worlds or sets of worlds. Nonetheless, these analyses demonstrate sufficient theoretical unity that they may be viewed, at an appropriate level of abstraction, as a single approach to the analysis of ability.
zh: (MA) 其实本身并不是一项分析，而是一个一般分析家族的模板。这个家族的不同成员将因其对 *C* 的不同候选者、以及量化的是单个世界还是世界组而彼此区别。尽管如此，这些分析展现出足够的理论统一性，可以在适当的抽象层面上被视为分析能力的单一进路。

en: Two points about (MA) bear noting. First, sometimes ‘modal’ is used loosely to describe phenomena that are connected to possibility (and necessity) in some way or other. The proponent of (MA) is concerned with modality in a stricter sense: she proposes that ability may be analyzed in terms of the precise framework of propositions and possible worlds just adumbrated. The opponent of (MA), in turn, grants that ability has something to do with possibility but denies that any such analysis succeeds.
zh: 关于 (MA) 有两点值得注意。第一，“模态的”一词有时被松散地用来描述与可能性（和必然性）以某种方式相联的现象。(MA) 的拥护者关心的是严格意义上的模态：她提出，能力可以按刚才粗描的那个由命题与可能世界构成的精确框架来分析。(MA) 的反对者则承认能力与可能性有关，但否认任何这类分析能成功。

en: Second, while (MA) has been presented as an alternative to (CA), (CA) is arguably just one particular version of (MA). For, as noted above, (CA) appeals to a subjunctive conditional, and the standard semantics for the subjunctive conditional (developed in slightly different ways in Stalnaker 1968 and Lewis 1973)[^lewis-1973][^stalnaker-1968] involve quantification over possible worlds. Specifically, (on Stalnaker’s version) a subjunctive conditional is true just in case its consequent is true at the world where its antecedent is true that is otherwise maximally similar to the actual world. In these terms, (CA) is roughly equivalent to the following:
zh: 第二，虽然 (MA) 是作为 (CA) 的替代方案给出的，(CA) 可以说只是 (MA) 的一个特定版本。因为如前所述，(CA) 诉诸虚拟条件句，而虚拟条件句的标准语义学（Stalnaker 1968 与 Lewis 1973 以略有不同的方式发展）[^lewis-1973][^stalnaker-1968]涉及对可能世界的量化。具体地说，（按 Stalnaker 的版本）一个虚拟条件句为真，当且仅当其后件在该条件句前件为真、且在其他方面与实际世界最大相似的世界为真。用这些术语说，(CA) 大致等价于：

en: **(CA_{modal})**
zh: **(CA_{modal})**

en: *S* has the ability to *A* iff *S* does *A* at a world at which *S* tries to *A* that is otherwise maximally similar to the actual world.
zh: *S* 拥有实施 *A* 的能力，当且仅当：*S* 在某个她尝试实施 *A*、且其他方面与实际世界最大相似的世界实施 *A*。

en: This is patently a version of (MA), with ‘*S* tries to *A* and is otherwise maximally similar to the actual world’ serving as condition *C*.
zh: 这显然是 (MA) 的一个版本，其中“*S* 尝试实施 *A* 且其他方面与实际世界最大相似”充当条件 *C*。

en: If this is correct, then most discussions of the analysis of ability in the twentieth century have focused on a special and somewhat idiosyncratic case of a much broader program of analysis, namely the program of giving a modal analysis of ability. The considerations brought forth in the remainder of this section, in contrast, are concerned with the general case.
zh: 如果这一点是对的，那么二十世纪关于能力分析的大多数讨论，聚焦于一个更广泛分析纲领——给出能力的模态分析——的一个特殊而多少特别的个案。本节余下部分提出的考量，针对的则是一般情形。

en: 4.2 The modal analysis: extensional adequacy
zh: 4.2 模态分析：外延得当性

en: There are two questions that might be raised for this proposal about ability. First, does ability indeed admit of some kind of modal analysis? Second, if it does, how exactly are we to spell out the details of that analysis — in particular, how are we to articulate condition C? Let us begin with the first, more basic, question.
zh: 对这一能力提案可以提出两个问题。第一，能力是否真的容许某种模态分析？第二，如果容许，这一分析的细节该如何展开——尤其是，条件 *C* 该如何陈述？让我们从第一个更基本的问题开始。

en: According to (MA), performing an act at some possible world (or set of worlds) is both necessary and sufficient for having the ability to perform that act. One way of challenging this claim is to deny the necessity claim: that is, to argue that it is sometimes the case that an agent is able to perform an act that she does not perform at any possible world.
zh: 按 (MA)，在某个可能世界（或世界组）实施一项行动，既是拥有实施该行动之能力的必要条件也是充分条件。挑战这一主张的一种方式，是否认其必要性：即论证，有时行动者能够实施一项她在任何可能世界都不实施的行动。

en: This is an argument that has in fact been made by several authors. Descartes, for one, appears to have argued that God is such an agent (Curley 1984)[^curley-1984]. A genuinely omnipotent being, one might argue, should be able to perform any act whatsoever, even the impossible ones. This view of omnipotence is contentious, but it is not clear that it should be ruled out formally, by the very analysis of ability, as (MA) does. Spencer (2017) argues that even non-omnipotent agents may sometimes have the ability to perform acts that they do not perform at any possible world.
zh: 事实上有好几位作者提出过这一论证。笛卡尔即是一例：他似乎主张上帝就是这样的行动者（Curley 1984）[^curley-1984]。人们可能论证，一个真正全能的存在者应当能实施任何行动，哪怕是不可能的行动。这种全能观有争议，但 (MA) 那样径直以能力分析把它在形式上排除出去，似乎并不应该。Spencer（2017）论证，即使非全能的行动者有时也可能拥有实施他们在任何可能世界都不实施之行动的能力。

en: Let us grant, however, that the possibility of performing an act is a necessary condition for the ability to perform that act, and that in this sense an attribution of ability entails a possibility claim. Another way to object to (MA) would be to challenge the sufficiency claim. Specifically, one might question whether there is any specification of *C* such that every agent who does *A* at a world (or set of worlds) that satisfies *C* is able to *A*. Before addressing this question, let us briefly review some proposed articulations of *C*.
zh: 然而，让我们退一步承认：实施一项行动的可能性是拥有实施该行动之能力的必要条件，且在此意义上能力归属蕴含一个可能性断言。反对 (MA) 的另一种方式是挑战其充分性。具体地说，人们可以追问：是否存在任何一种对 *C* 的刻画，使得凡在满足 *C* 的世界（或世界组）实施 *A* 的行动者都能实施 *A*。在处理这个问题之前，让我们先简述几种已提出的对 *C* 的刻画。

en: To begin with, one might suggest that what an agent is able to do just is what is possible for her to do relative to the past and the laws of nature (van Inwagen 1983)[^inwagen-1983], or else what is possible relative to all agential-level facts (but not all physical-level facts) (List 2014)[^list-2014]. In each case, condition *C* specifies that relevant worlds share some of their features with the actual world. Note that the above specifications aim to capture in the first place what it takes to have a specific ability. General ability would seem to require a rather different analysis.
zh: 首先，有人提出：行动者能做的事，恰恰就是相对于过去与自然律而言对她可能的事（van Inwagen 1983）[^inwagen-1983]，或者相对于全部行动者层面事实（而非全部物理层面事实）可能的事（List 2014）[^list-2014]。无论哪种情形，条件 *C* 都规定相关世界与实际世界共享某些特征。注意，上述刻画的首先都是拥有特定能力的条件；一般能力看来需要一种相当不同的分析。

en: Alternatively, on a seminal account introduced by Lewis (1976) and refined in Kratzer’s treatment of ‘can’ (1977, 1981, 2012), *C* is contextually determined. This is to say that whether a statement of the form ‘*S* has the ability to *A*’ is true depends on the context in which it is made. To illustrate this point, consider the following example. Suppose that it is possible for Jane to ride her bike given various stable facts about her internal constitution, but not given the fact that her bike was stolen. On the contextualist specification of (MA), whether these facts about Jane and her environment suffice to say that she has the ability to ride her bike depends on the precise fact about Jane the ability claim is meant to pick out. In some contexts, we are concerned with what Jane is able to do (almost) precisely as things stand. In others, we care about what she can do quite generally, independently of whether she has access to the right resources. Condition *C* differs depending on these interests. An advantage of this approach is that it can be employed to provide truth conditions for general and specific ability claims alike.
zh: 另一种做法，是在 Lewis（1976）的开创性说明中、并在 Kratzer 对“能（can）”的处理（1977, 1981, 2012）中得到精炼的方案：*C* 由语境决定。也就是说，“*S* 拥有实施 *A* 的能力”这类陈述是否为真，取决于做出该陈述的语境。举例说明：设想 Jane 能骑她的自行车，这相对于她内部构造的各种稳定事实是可能的；但相对于“她的自行车被偷了”这一事实则不可能。按 (MA) 的语境主义刻画，关于 Jane 与其环境的这些事实是否足以说“她拥有骑自行车的能力”，取决于能力断言想要挑出关于 Jane 的哪个确切事实。在有些语境中，我们关心的是 Jane 在（几乎）现状如其所是的情况下能做什么；在另一些语境中，我们关心的是她一般能做什么，而不论她能否获得所需的资源。条件 *C* 随这些关切而不同。这一进路的一个优点是：它可以同时为一般与特定的能力断言提供真值条件。

en: Regardless of its appeal as a semantics for ability ascriptions, one might be skeptical of the promise of this contextualist version of (MA) as an analysis of ability in the material mode. In particular, while it may seem plausible that ability claims expressed in different contexts track different features of an agent, one might think it *im*plausible that an agent’s possession of abilities associated with those features depends, metaphysically speaking, on the interests of speakers in some context.
zh: 尽管作为能力归属的语义学有其吸引力，人们仍可能怀疑这一语境主义版本的 (MA) 作为物质模态意义上的能力分析之前景。特别是，虽然“不同语境中表达的能力断言追踪行动者的不同特征”似乎讲得通，但人们可能认为，行动者拥有与那些特征相联的能力，在形而上学上依赖于某个语境中说话者的兴趣，这是 ** 不 ** 可信的。

en: Returning now to whether (MA) provides a sufficient condition for ability, some theorists have argued that there is no possible specification of *C* such that every agent who *A’*s at a world that satisfies *C* is able to *A*. For instance, Schwarz (2020, see also Willer 2021)[^willer-2021] proposes that no particular specification of *C* guarantees that the agent’s *A*ing is, in the right way, under their control. Put differently, it being possible (relative to some set of facts) that an agent *A*’s doesn’t seem to ensure that the agent can actively bring it about that they *A*.
zh: 回到 (MA) 是否为能力提供充分条件的问题：一些理论家已论证，不存在任何对 *C* 的刻画，使得凡在满足 *C* 的世界实施 *A* 的行动者都能实施 *A*。例如 Schwarz（2020；另见 Willer 2021）[^willer-2021]提出，对 *C* 的任何特定刻画都不能保证行动者的实施 *A* 之举动以恰当的方式处于其控制之下。换个说法：行动者实施 *A* 是可能的（相对于某组事实），似乎并不确保该行动者能主动促成其实施 *A*。

en: Since there are countless possible specifications of *C*, showing definitively that (MA) cannot provide a sufficient condition for ability is a difficult task. Still, the objection points to a broader concern: *even if* we can specify *C* such that (MA) delivers a sufficient condition for ability, it remains to be seen whether this can be achieved without appeal to some other agentive modal notion in the process (for discussion see Maier 2015)[^maier-2015]. Suppose, for example, that for (MA) to specify a sufficient condition, the relevant restriction can only be formulated as follows: ‘for *S* to be able to *A* is for it to be possible that *S* *A*’s relative to what is within *S*’s power to do’. Since this version of (MA) appeals to the ability-adjacent notion of what is within an agent’s power to do, it arguably fails to provide a reductive analysis of ability in terms of *S*’s *A*ing at some (set of) possible world(s).
zh: 由于 *C* 的可能刻画数不胜数，要定论 (MA) 不能为能力提供充分条件，是件难事。尽管如此，这一异议指向一个更广的担忧：** 即使 ** 我们能把 *C* 刻画得让 (MA) 给出能力的充分条件，仍待考察的是：这一成就能否不诉诸任何其他行动者性模态概念而达成（讨论见 Maier 2015）[^maier-2015]。例如设想：为了让 (MA) 给出充分条件，相关限制只能这样表述——“*S* 能实施 *A*，就是 *S* 实施 *A* 相对于其力所能及者而言是可能的”。由于这一版本的 (MA) 诉诸“力所能及”这一与能力相邻的概念，它可以说未能提供一种以 *S* 在某个（组）可能世界实施 *A* 来还原能力的分析。

en: 4.3 The modal analysis: logical considerations
zh: 4.3 模态分析：逻辑方面的考量

en: A different way to resist the view that ability admits of a modal analysis is developed in a prescient discussion by Anthony Kenny (Kenny 1975; the presentation of Kenny here is indebted to the discussion in Brown 1988)[^brown-1988][^kenny-1975]. Kenny argues that, if something like (MA) is indeed true, then ability should obey the principles that govern the possibility operator in standard modal logics. Kenny claims that ability fails to satisfy the following two principles:
zh: Anthony Kenny 的一段先见之明的讨论发展出另一条拒绝“能力容许模态分析”的道路（Kenny 1975；此处对 Kenny 的呈现受惠于 Brown 1988 的讨论）[^brown-1988][^kenny-1975]。Kenny 论证：如果类似 (MA) 的东西确实为真，那么能力就应当服从标准模态逻辑中支配可能性算子的诸原理。Kenny 主张，能力不满足以下两条原理：

en: $A \to \Diamond A.$
zh: $A \to \Diamond A.$

en: Informally, (1) expresses the principle that if an agent performs an action, then she has the ability to perform this action. This is, Kenny argues, false of ability.
zh: 非正式地说，(1) 表达的是：如果行动者实施了一项行动，她就拥有实施该行动的能力。Kenny 论证，这对能力而言为假。

en: $\Diamond(A \lor B) \to (\Diamond A \lor \Diamond B).$
zh: $\Diamond(A \lor B) \to (\Diamond A \lor \Diamond B).$

en: Informally, (2) expresses the principle that if an agent has the ability to perform one of two actions, then she has the ability to perform either the first action or the second action. This is, Kenny argues, false of ability.
zh: 非正式地说，(2) 表达的是：如果行动者拥有实施两项行动之一的能力，她就拥有实施第一项或第二项行动的能力。Kenny 论证，这对能力而言为假。

en: Let us begin with (1). Kenny claims that this principle is false in light of cases like the following: ‘A hopeless darts player may, once in a lifetime, hit the bull, but be unable to repeat the performance because he does not have the ability to hit the bull’ (Kenny 1975, 136)[^kenny-1975]. This kind of ‘fluky success’ has been extensively discussed in the philosophical literature — perhaps most famously in Austin (1956) — in order to make a variety of points. Kenny’s insight is to observe that these simple cases tell against the modal analysis of ability, as they violate an axiom of many modal logics, namely any system as strong as the system **T** (for an introduction to various systems and their axioms, see the entry on modal logic).
zh: 先看 (1)。Kenny 主张，鉴于如下类型的情形，这条原理为假：“一个无可救药的飞镖选手可能一辈子有一次命中靶心，却无法重复这一表现，因为他没有命中靶心的能力”（Kenny 1975, 136）[^kenny-1975]。这类“侥幸命中”（fluky success）在哲学文献中已被广泛讨论——也许最著名的是 Austin（1956）——用以支持各种论点。Kenny 的洞见在于观察到：这些简单情形违反了诸多模态逻辑的一条公理——即任何不弱于系统 **T** 的系统——因而对能力的模态分析不利（对各种系统及其公理的介绍，参见模态逻辑词条）。

en: A simple response to this point is to deny that **T** (or any stronger logic) is the correct logic for ability. To deny this is still to allow for a treatment of ability within the framework of possible worlds. Notably, the modal logic **K** is one that fails to validate (1). A natural response to Kenny’s first point, then, is to say that **K**, rather than **T** or some stronger system, is the correct modal logic of ability.
zh: 对这一点的简单回应，是否认 **T** （或任何更强的逻辑）是能力的正确逻辑。但这样做仍允许在可能世界框架内处理能力。值得注意的是，模态逻辑 **K** 恰恰不验证 (1)。于是，对 Kenny 第一点的自然回应是说：能力的正确模态逻辑是 **K**，而非 **T** 或某个更强的系统。

en: This response is not available, however, in response to Kenny’s second objection. Recall that objection was that (2) is true of possibility but not of ability. Here the retreat to weaker modal logics will not work, since (2) is provable on the weakest standard modal logic, namely **K**. Yet the parallel claim does not seem true of ability. Kenny gives the following example:
zh: 然而，这一回应在 Kenny 的第二个异议面前不可得。回顾该异议：(2) 对可能性为真，对能力则不然。这里退到更弱的模态逻辑行不通，因为 (2) 在最弱的标准模态逻辑 **K** 上就可证明。而平行的主张对能力而言似乎不真。Kenny 给出如下例子：

en: Given a pack of cards, I have the ability to pick out on request a card which is either black or red; but I don’t have the ability to pick out a red card on request nor the ability to pick out a black card on request. (Kenny 1975, 137)[^kenny-1975]
zh: 给定一副牌，我有应请求挑出一张红色或黑色牌的能力；但我没有应请求挑出一张红牌的能力，也没有应请求挑出一张黑牌的能力。（Kenny 1975, 137）[^kenny-1975]

en: This then appears to be a case where *S* has the ability to *A* or *B* but lacks the ability to *A* and lacks the ability to *B*. So it appears that (2) is false of ability. In light of this Kenny concludes that ‘if we regard possible worlds semantics as making explicit what is involved in being a possibility, we must say that ability is not any kind of possibility’ (Kenny 1975, 140)[^kenny-1975].
zh: 于是这似乎是一个 *S* 拥有实施 *A* 或 *B* 的能力、却既缺乏实施 *A* 的能力也缺乏实施 *B* 的能力的情形。如此看来，(2) 对能力为假。有鉴于此，Kenny 得出结论：“如果我们把可能世界语义学视为把‘作为可能性’所涉及的东西显式化，那我们就必须说：能力不是任何一种可能性”（Kenny 1975, 140）[^kenny-1975]。

en: To appreciate Kenny’s conclusion, it is instructive to work through why precisely this is a counterexample to (MA). Consider an agent *S* who has the ability to pick a red card or a black card, but does not have the ability to pick a red card or the ability to pick a black card. According to (MA), *S* has the ability to *A* iff *S* does *A* at some world (or set of worlds) satisfying condition *C*. Consider the case where (MA) appeals to a single world, not a set of worlds. If *S* has the ability to pick a red card or pick a black card, then by (MA) there is a world *w* satisfying condition *C* where *S* picks a red card or black card. Then either *S* picks a red card at *w* or *S* picks a black card at *w*. Then, applying (MA) now in the other direction, *S* has the ability to pick a red card or *S* has the ability to pick a black card. But that, by assumption, is not the case. Since (MA) is the only substantive premise appealed to that argument, (MA) must be rejected.
zh: 为领会 Kenny 的结论，推演一下为什么这恰恰构成对 (MA) 的反例是有益的。考虑一位拥有“挑红牌或黑牌”之能力、却没有“挑红牌”之能力也没有“挑黑牌”之能力的行动者 *S*。按 (MA)，*S* 拥有实施 *A* 的能力，当且仅当 *S* 在某个满足条件 *C* 的世界（或世界组）实施 *A*。考虑 (MA) 诉诸单个世界而非世界组的情形。如果 *S* 拥有挑红牌或挑黑牌的能力，那么按 (MA)，存在一个满足条件 *C* 的世界 *w*，在其中 *S* 挑一张红牌或黑牌。于是在 *w*，要么 *S* 挑红牌，要么 *S* 挑黑牌。再按 (MA) 反向施用：*S* 拥有挑红牌的能力，或 *S* 拥有挑黑牌的能力。但按假设，情形并非如此。既然 (MA) 是该论证所诉诸的唯一实质前提，(MA) 必须被拒斥。

en: Note that this argument turned essentially on adopting the version of (MA) which appeals to a single world, rather than a set of worlds. So one way of responding to this objection is by appealing to sets of worlds in the modal analysis of ability. Modal accounts that appeal to sets of worlds are ‘non-normal’ in the sense that they do not satisfy the axiom **K**, but they remain true to the letter of (MA) as well as the spirit of modal analyses generally, insofar as they avail themselves only of possible worlds and quantification thereover. This type of view has been proposed by Mark Brown, who argues that, if we take accessibility relations to hold between a world and a set of worlds, then we may capture talk of ability within a possible worlds framework that is broadly in the spirit of standard views (Brown 1988; for recent proposals along these lines see Kikkert 2022; Storrs-Fox 2023)[^brown-1988][^kikkert-2022][^storrs-fox-2023]. Views of this type aim to capture that not just any instance of *S*’s *A*ing entails that *S* was able to *A*. Instead, an agent must succeed reliably enough across certain nearby worlds for their *A*ing to count as sufficiently controlled.
zh: 注意，这一论证本质上依赖于采纳诉诸单个世界而非世界组的 (MA) 版本。所以回应这一异议的一种方式，是在能力的模态分析中诉诸世界组。诉诸世界组的模态说明是“非正规的”（non-normal）——它们不满足公理 **K**——但它们仍忠于 (MA) 的字面与模态分析总体的精神，因为它们只动用可能世界及其上的量化。这一类型的看法由 Mark Brown 提出，他论证：如果我们取可达关系成立于一个世界与一组世界之间，那么我们就能在一个广义上符合标准看法精神的可能世界框架内刻画能力之谈（Brown 1988；沿此路线的晚近提案见 Kikkert 2022；Storrs-Fox 2023）[^brown-1988][^kikkert-2022][^storrs-fox-2023]。这类看法旨在刻画：并非 *S* 实施 *A* 的任何实例都蕴含 *S* 曾能实施 *A*；毋宁说，行动者必须在某些邻近世界中足够可靠地成功，其实施 *A* 之举才算受到足够的控制。

en: Alternatively, we may take this point to militate in favor of a return to hypothetical theories of ability, since, at least on Lewis’s view of subjunctive conditionals, it may be that a disjunction follows from a counterfactual claim without either of its disjuncts following from that claim (Lewis 1973, 79–80)[^lewis-1973].
zh: 另一种选择是，我们可以让这一点转而支持回到假设式能力理论：因为至少按 Lewis 对虚拟条件句的看法，一个析取式可以从一个反事实断言推出，而它的任何一个析取支都不必从该断言推出（Lewis 1973, 79–80）[^lewis-1973]。

en: 4.4 Alternative non-hypothetical accounts
zh: 4.4 其他非假设式说明

en: The foregoing has indicated serious concerns about the adequacy of two orthodox approaches to ability: the conditional analysis (CA), and the modal analysis (MA), of which (CA) is arguably just a special case. This raises the question of what a non-hypothetical and non-modal account of ability and its attribution might look like.
zh: 前文已指出两种正统能力进路的得当性疑虑：条件句分析 (CA)，以及模态分析 (MA)——(CA) 可以说只是后者的特例。这就引出问题：一种既非假设式又非模态的能力及其归属的说明会是什么样子？

en: Since abilities are a kind of power, one natural idea is to analyze ability in terms of some better understood power. As we have seen in Section 3.4, this is the route the new dispositionalist takes when she proposes to analyze abilities in terms of dispositions. However, where the new dispositionalist subsequently gives a hypothetical account of dispositions, proponents of other power-based views characterize the type of power in terms of which they analyze ability in a non-hypothetical manner.
zh: 既然能力是诸力的一种，一个自然的想法是借某种更好理解的力来分析能力。如第 3.4 节所见，这正是新倾向主义者提出以倾向分析能力时所走的路。不过，新倾向主义者随后给倾向的是一种假设式说明，而其他基于力的观点的拥护者则以非假设式的方式刻画他们借以分析能力的那种力。

en: A first non-hypothetical analysis of ability as a kind of power can be found in the work of Barbara Vetter (2013, 2015). On Vetter’s view, to have an ability is to have a certain kind of *potentiality*. Both agents and objects may possess potentialities, and their possession of these potentialities is more fundamental, metaphysically speaking, than what goes on at other possible worlds. Unlike traditional dispositions, which involve a dyadic relation between a stimulus and a manifestation (for example: a glass is disposed to break when struck), potentialities involve a monadic relation to a manifestation (for example: a glass has the potential to break). On first sight, this makes potentiality well-suited to account for ability. Abilities, like potentialities, appear to involve a monadic relation to an act (e.g., I am able to *play tennis*). One challenge for this view is that Vetter takes potentialities to obey the principles of possibility that caused trouble for (MA) (see §4.3). This means that an explanation of why ability violates these principles must be sought outside of its being a kind of potentiality.
zh: 把能力作为某种力来分析的第一种非假设式说明，见于 Barbara Vetter（2013, 2015）的工作。按 Vetter 的看法，拥有一种能力就是拥有一种特定的 ** 潜能 ** （potentiality）。行动者与对象都可以拥有潜能；而在形而上学上说，潜能的拥有比其他可能世界中的情形更为根本。传统倾向涉及刺激与显现之间的二元关系（例如：玻璃杯倾向于被撞即碎），潜能则不同，它涉及与显现之间的一元关系（例如：玻璃杯拥有破碎的潜能）。乍看之下，这使潜能很适合说明能力：与潜能一样，能力似乎涉及与一项行动的一元关系（例如：我 ** 能打网球 **）。这一看法的一个挑战是：Vetter 让潜能服从那些曾给 (MA) 制造麻烦的可能性原理（见 §4.3）。这意味着，为什么能力会违反这些原理，其解释必须到“能力是一种潜能”之外去寻找。

en: A different power-based view is suggested by Helen Steward, whose work emphasizes the traditional notion of a “two-way power” (Steward 2012, 2020; see also Alvarez 2013)[^alvarez-2013][^steward-2012]. Steward argues that actions are exercises of two-way powers— “powers which an agent can exercise or not at a given moment, even holding all prior conditions at that moment fixed” (Steward 2020, 345)[^steward-2020]. These are to be contrasted with one-way powers, which manifest whenever their manifestation conditions are realized, as a fragile glass that breaks whenever it is struck. Unlike the new dispositionalists on the one hand and Vetter on the other, Steward sees a fundamental asymmetry between agents, who are bearers of two-way powers, and mere objects, who are bearers only of one-way powers. It is natural then to think that what it is to have an ability is to have a two-way power of a certain kind, and that a theory of ability should follow from an account of agency in terms of two-way powers.
zh: 另一种基于力的看法由 Helen Steward 提出，其工作强调“双向力”（two-way power）这一传统概念（Steward 2012, 2020；另见 Alvarez 2013）[^alvarez-2013][^steward-2012]。Steward 论证：行动是双向力的施行——“行动者在给定时刻可以施行也可以不施行的力，即使把该时刻的一切先前条件都固定下来”（Steward 2020, 345）[^steward-2020]。与单向力对照：单向力只要其显现条件实现就会显现，正如易碎的玻璃杯被撞即碎。与新倾向主义者和 Vetter 都不同，Steward 看到行动者——双向力的承载者——与单纯对象——单向力的承载者——之间存在根本的不对称。于是自然想到：拥有能力是怎么回事，就是拥有某种双向力；而能力理论应当从一种以双向力为纲的行动性（agency）说明中推演出来。

en: Still other approaches to ability reject (CA) and (MA) while rejecting also the thought that having an ability is having some other kind of power — be it a disposition, a potentiality, or a two-way power. One such account is developed by John Maier (2018, 2022), who argues that ability is best understood in terms of options. Roughly, options are those acts that are open to an agent at a given time. Importantly, what it takes for an action to be open to an agent is not further analyzable in terms of quantification over possible worlds. To have a general ability, according to Maier, just is to have a particular pattern of options. This view thereby runs counter to many other accounts of ability, including new dispositionalist views and Vetter’s potentiality-based account, which take general abilities to be fundamental.
zh: 还有一些能力进路同时拒绝 (CA) 与 (MA)，也拒绝“拥有能力就是拥有某种其他的力——无论是倾向、潜能还是双向力”这一想法。其中一种说明由 John Maier（2018, 2022）发展，他论证：能力最好以选项（options）来理解。粗略地说，选项是行动者在给定时刻向其敞开的那些行动。重要的是，一项行动向行动者敞开是怎么回事，不能进一步以对可能世界的量化来分析。按 Maier 的说法，拥有一般能力恰恰就是拥有一特定模式的选项。因此这一看法与许多其他能力说明相抵触，包括把一般能力当作根本的新倾向主义看法与 Vetter 的潜能说。

en: Finally, a fourth type of non-hypothetical account might be gleaned from Lewis’ posthumously published compatibilist account of abilities. Lewis’ analysis, roughly, is that *S* has the ability to perform an action *A* just in case there is some basic action, *B*, such that (i) doing *B* would constitute doing *A*, and (ii) there is no obstacle to *S*’s doing *B*. The problem of giving a theory of ability then becomes the problem of giving a theory of obstacles, something at which Lewis, in his outline, makes a beginning (see Beebee et al. 2020 for further discussion)[^beebee-2020].
zh: 最后，可以由 Lewis 身后发表的相容论能力说明中提炼出第四种非假设式说明。Lewis 的分析粗略地是：*S* 拥有实施行动 *A* 的能力，当且仅当存在某个基本行动 *B*，使得 (i) 做 *B* 将构成做 *A*，且 (ii) *S* 做 *B* 没有障碍。于是给出能力理论的问题，就变成给出障碍理论的问题；Lewis 在其大纲中对此开了个头（进一步讨论见 Beebee et al. 2020）[^beebee-2020]。

en: It is something of an open question whether on this proposal, ultimately, facts about abilities reduce to facts about what happens at other possible worlds. What *is* clear is that this proposal, if it can be understood as a form of (MA) at all, would constitute a significantly more complex modal analysis than that suggested by Lewis in earlier work (1976). Lewis’ proposal is an inspiration for further research in at least two ways. First, it indicates that Lewis, a systematic philosopher of modality, saw the problem of giving an analysis of ability as a significant outstanding project. Second, it demonstrates that genuinely novel approaches remain available and the project of giving an analysis of ability may yet be in its early stages.
zh: 按这一提案，关于能力的事实归根结底是否还原为关于其他可能世界中情形的事实，这多少是个开放问题。** 确定 ** 的是：这一提案如果还能被理解为 (MA) 的一种形式，它将构成一个远比 Lewis 早期工作（1976）所提示的更为复杂的模态分析。Lewis 的提案至少在两方面启发着进一步研究。第一，它表明这位模态形而上学的系统哲学家把能力分析问题视为一项重要的未竟事业。第二，它表明真正新颖的进路依然可得，给出能力分析的工程或许才刚刚起步。

en: 5. Applying the theory of ability
zh: 5 能力理论的应用

en: Thus far our questions about abilities have been formal ones: we have been asking what it is to have an ability, without concerning ourselves with the substantive work that a theory of ability might have to do. But abilities are in fact central to a range of philosophical topics. Let us therefore consider some applications of a theory of abilitiy.
zh: 迄今我们关于能力的问题是形式性的：我们一直在问拥有能力是怎么回事，而没有关心能力理论可能要承担的实质工作。但能力实际上是一系列哲学论题的核心。因此，让我们考察能力理论的一些应用。

en: 5.1 Ability and the free will debates
zh: 5.1 能力与自由意志论辩

en: Perhaps the most prominent substantive role for a theory of ability has been the uses to which accounts of ability have been put in the free will debates.
zh: 能力理论最突出的实质角色，也许是能力说明在自由意志论辩中的种种用途。

en: Questions about abilities have figured most prominently in debates over compatibilism. ‘Compatibilism’ is used in many ways, but let us understand it here as the thesis that the ability to perform actions one does not perform is compossible with the truth of determinism, which we may take to be the view that the facts about the past and the laws jointly determine the facts about the present and all future moments, or what we might call compatibilism about freedom and determinism. Insofar as compatibilism, so understood, has been explicitly defended, these defenses have often made appeal to theories of ability, notably the conditional analysis and its variants.
zh: 关于能力的问题在相容论的论辩中最为突出。“相容论”有很多用法，但这里我们把它理解为这样一个论题：实施一个人并不实施之行动的能力，与决定论的真可以共存——决定论可取为这样一种看法：关于过去与自然律的事实共同决定了关于现在与一切未来时刻的事实。这就是所谓关于自由与决定论的相容论。就如此理解的相容论得到明确辩护而言，这些辩护常常诉诸能力理论，尤其是条件句分析及其变种。

en: In our discussion of the conditional analysis, we distinguished between global and local counterexamples to hypothetical theories of ability, where the former appealed to the fact that any such theory would render ability compatible with determinism which, according to the objector, it is not. These counterexamples are in a certain way dialectically ineffective: if someone doubts whether determinism is in fact incompatible with ability claims, these kinds of counterexamples will not convince her. But compatibilitsts have often been guilty of what seems to be the opposite mistake. Namely, they have offered theories of ability which show abilities to be compatible with determinism, and have argued from this to the claim that such abilities are indeed compatible with determinism.
zh: 在讨论条件句分析时，我们区分了假设式能力理论的全局反例与局部反例：前者诉诸“任何此类理论都会使能力与决定论相容——而按异议者的说法，这是不对的”这一事实。这类反例在某种意义上是辩证无力的：如果有人怀疑决定论是否真的与能力断言不相容，这类反例说服不了她。但相容论者却常常犯下看似相反的错误：他们提出使能力与决定论相容的能力理论，然后从中论证“这类能力确实与决定论相容”。

en: The shortcomings of this strategy are nicely diagnosed by Peter van Inwagen. After surveying the local counterexamples that arise for various hypothetical theories of ability, van Inwagen imagines that we have arrived at the best possible hypothetical theory of ability, which he labels “the Analysis”. van Inwagen then writes:
zh: 这一策略的短处被 Peter van Inwagen 恰当地诊断出来。在综述了各种假设式能力理论面临的局部反例之后，van Inwagen 设想我们已经得到了最好的假设式能力理论，他称之为“该分析”（the Analysis）。van Inwagen 接着写道：

en: What does the Analysis do for us? How does it affect our understanding of the Compatibility Problem? It does very little for us, so far as I can see, unless we have some reason to think it is *correct*.
